name: Poison Spray
description:
You and your Symbiotes exude a spray of poisonous spores. You take 1 damage. Roll Spirit vs Fortitude against an adjacent creature. On a win, the creature takes 1d12 damage. On a loss, half damage.

Describe the effects of the poison.
successes:
✨: Add HEART to the damage roll.

🌞: Repeat the roll and damage next round.
